meta.title: Compare
meta.description: Compare Deadlock heroes, builds or players side by side. Differences are stated only when the data supports them.

title: Compare
description: Side by side, with key differences first. A difference is only stated when the data separates the two sides.

empty.pickPlayers: Enter two SteamID3s (find them via player search).
empty.pickBuilds: Choose a hero, then set build A and build B.
empty.buildNotFoundDescription: One of the builds isn’t available.
empty.playerNotFoundDescription: One of the accounts has no public profile or stored matches.

pickers.needId: Need an ID? <link>Search players</link> and copy it from their profile.

parts.noDifferences: No clear differences in {scope}: every compared win-rate interval overlaps, and no other measure differs enough to call.
parts.noneAhead: No measure where {name} is clearly ahead.
parts.differencesRule: Listed only when the 95% intervals don’t overlap (win rates) or the gap is large (popularity). These describe measured results, not causes.
parts.similar: Similar: intervals overlap or a sample is small.
parts.barsLegend: Scale {scale}, center line 50%, whisker = 95% interval; faded = low sample.
parts.sparkTooFew: Not enough daily data to chart.
parts.sparkCaption: Daily win rate across the window (dashed 50%). Days with too few matches are left out.

heroes.together: On the same team: {rate} over {count} matches.
heroes.notTogether: Not enough matches together on one team.
heroes.rankDescription: By match average rank (matches without one aren’t counted).
heroes.matchupsDescription: Best and worst lane opponents (100+ games).

builds.differentHeroes: These builds are for different heroes, so their win rates also reflect the heroes. Each is compared with its own hero instead.
builds.phasesDescription: By when each hero’s players actually buy these items on average.

players.atGlanceDescription: Stored normal-mode matches. Results, not skill ratings.
players.sharedHeroesDescription: Heroes both have played; most-played first.
players.trendDescription: Per block of 20 matches, oldest → newest.
players.headToHeadDescription: From each other’s top-10 teammate and opponent lists.
players.mates: Teammates in {count} matches; {name} won {rate} of them.
players.notMates: Not among each other’s most frequent teammates.
players.notOpponents: Not among each other’s most frequent opponents.

differences.groupsAll: Higher win rate in all {of} {group, select, length {match lengths} rank {rank bands} other {shared heroes}}
differences.groupsSome: Higher win rate in {count} of {of} {group, select, length {match lengths} rank {rank bands} other {shared heroes}}
differences.risingDetail: Last 7 days vs the 7 before: intervals don’t overlap
differences.aboveHero: Above its hero’s overall win rate
